notes: launch discipline: the packaged app is always launched with a clean profile (fresh HOME/XDG/TMPDIR) and a NEUTRAL cwd (the clean profile HOME, like a real desktop user), never from inside a repository checkout — the current artifact's agent resolver is cwd-sensitive (findUpward from process.cwd() can bind a repo dev agent when launched from inside a checkout, which breaks its first-run storage preparation); observed and recorded honestly, harness avoids it by construction
